# How much should you pad your next estimate?

> Free estimate buffer calculator for freelancers, agencies and contractors. Paste your finished projects (estimate and actual) to see how your estimates really miss, the hours or price that covers 80% of outcomes on the next job, and the chance a fixed price loses money. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
